species: Mouse E14 and J1 ESCs were cultured on plates coated with 0.2% gelatin
cell_type: Endogenous retroviruses (ERVs) were usually silenced by various histone modifications on histone H3 variants and respective histone chaperones in embryonic stem cells (ESCs).
sample_source: E14 ESCs expressing 3HA-Ssrp1 and control E14 ESCs expressing pCAG-3HA were used
cell_line: E14 ESCs expressing 3HA-Ssrp1 and control E14 ESCs expressing pCAG-3HA were used were washed with pre-cooled PBS and lysed in 1 ml pre-cooled lysis buffer... and loaded to 10% SDS-PAGE for silver-staining and mass spectrometry.
